name: Qwen3.8 Max (0902)
description: Qwen3.8-Max-0902 (alias qwen3.8-max-2026-09-02) is an upgraded QwenCloud snapshot of Qwen3.8 Max, further post-trained for coding and cowork. Alibaba reports gains handling more complex engineering-scale software projects and long-horizon autonomous development, stronger collaborative agent behavior across multi-tool orchestration and end-to-end task delivery, and refined native vision understanding for chart reasoning, document parsing, and multimodal perception. It retains the 1M-token context window, thinking mode, and full tool ecosystem of Qwen3.8 Max, with a 128,000-token maximum output and a 256,000-token thinking budget. Accessible via QwenCloud as a dated, pinnable snapshot; Alibaba's changelog does not publish new quantitative benchmark scores or a model-specific price table for this snapshot.
